```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'parsed entity content'>">
  %ent;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special chars: <>&"' -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with <tags> and &entities; inside.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item code ID #REQUIRED>
  <!ENTITY base "Standard Item">
  <!ENTITY ext "&base; Extended">
]>
<?xml-processing-instruction target="compiler" data="optimize=true"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Multi-line
       comment block
       for catalog header -->
  <item code="i1" xlink:type="simple">&ext;</item>
  <item code="i2">
    <![CDATA[Unparsed CDATA section with a fake entity &base;]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent_param 'parameter expansion'>">
  %param;
  <!ENTITY ent_gen "General Entity">
]>
<?target-pi data-attribute="value"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/document" xmlns:ns="http://xml.org/ns">
  <!-- Document level comment covering parser directives -->
  <ns:section>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA content section 1 with &ent_gen;
    ]]>
  </ns:section>
  <section>&ent_gen;</section>
</document>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (product*)>
  <!ELEMENT product (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; Beta">
  <!ENTITY e3 "&e2; Gamma">
  <!NOTATION notation-type SYSTEM "notation.dat">
  <!ENTITY ent-ndata SYSTEM "binary.dat" NDATA notation-type>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="inventory.css"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.com/inv" xmlns:inv="http://example.com/inv/sub">
  <!-- Comment: Testing deep entity expansions and CDATA coexistence -->
  <inv:product>
    <![CDATA[
      <product-info code="XYZ">
        Description: &e3;
      </product-info>
    ]]>
  </inv:product>
  <product>&e3;</product>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE system [
  <!ELEMENT system (node)*>
  <!ELEMENT node (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY local "LocalEntityValue">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ENTITY local-param 'ParamValue'>">
  %p1;
]>
<?dbhtml filename="index.html"?>
<system xmlns="http://example.net/sys" xmlns:meta="http://example.net/meta">
  <!-- Comment 1: Before CDATA block -->
  <meta:node id="n1">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw data: node &local; and text.
    ]]>
  </meta:node>
  <!-- Comment 2: Between nodes -->
  <node>&local; &local-param;</node>
</system>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY default-text "Default Archive Text">
  <!NOTATION text-notation SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY external-file SYSTEM "ext.txt" NDATA text-notation>
]>
<?xml-log level="debug" destination="stdout"?>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:arc="http://example.org/archive/ns">
  <!-- Comment with dashes -- and markup symbols < > & -->
  <arc:file name="test1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA with markup: <file>data</file>
    ]]>
  </arc:file>
  <file>&default-text;</file>
</archive>

<!DOCTYPE config [
  <!ELEMENT config (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY setting-val "True">

]>

    <![CDATA[
      Setting state: &setting-val;
    ]]>
  </cfg:setting>
  <setting>&setting-val;</setting>
</config>

    <![CDATA[
      UI Module CDATA content with reference &mod-name;
    ]]>
  </ui:module>
  <module>&mod-name; - &pe-val;</module>
</application>
